status: T4 STRONG-EVIDENCE analytic UV obstruction; operator reproduction and counterterm closure remain open
scope: Canonical A1 full-production quadratic Gaussian on the fixed L=16 three-torus, three complex components, eta_shell=0, sharp max-norm spectral cutoff, fixed positive rho and Class-II mass regularisers, and the embedded Pauli T1/T2/T3 derivative currents. The result concerns bare Gaussian-reference ultraviolet power counting only.

convention.fourier_modes: k_n=(2*pi/L)n with max_j |n_j|<=N and Psi(x)=V^-1/2 sum_n Psi_n exp(i k_n.x)
convention.real_gaussian: Re Psi_n and Im Psi_n are six real Gaussian coordinates with covariance A(k)^-1, as induced by exp[-(1/2) Psi_n^dagger A(k) Psi_n]
convention.complex_mode_covariance: E[Psi_n Psi_n^dagger]=2 A(k)^-1; the factor 2 is load-bearing
convention.one_axis_derivative_covariance: D_N=(2/(3V)) sum_n |k_n|^2 A(k_n)^-1 by cube symmetry

analytic_targets.point_limit: C_N -> C_infinity as a finite positive matrix because A(k)^-1=O(|k|^-4)
analytic_targets.conditional_currents: with q_A=m_A/(rho+eps_rho), v_A=(T_A-q_A I)Psi: E sum_i J_A,i^2=6 E[(T_A Psi)^dagger D_N(T_A Psi)], E sum_i J_A,i K_A,i=6 E Re[(T_A Psi)^dagger D_N v_A], E sum_i K_A,i^2=6 E[v_A^dagger D_N v_A]
analytic_targets.leading_contraction: E[e_ClassII,N | Psi]=delta_cube*N*W_eps(Psi)+o(N), where W_eps=3 sum_A[a|T_A Psi|^2+2b Re((T_A Psi)^dagger v_A)+c|v_A|^2]
analytic_targets.fierz_form: for s=|Psi_1|^2+|Psi_2|^2 and rho=|Psi|^2, W_eps=9(a+2b+c)s-6b s^2/(rho+eps_rho)-3c s^2(rho+2eps_rho)/(rho+eps_rho)^2
analytic_targets.positivity: the pinned 2x2 coefficient matrix [[a,b],[b,c]] is positive definite, so W_eps is nonnegative and nonzero on an open set; its Gaussian expectation is strictly positive
analytic_targets.bare_L1_obstruction: E[e_ClassII,N]/N converges to a strictly positive coefficient, so the bare positive Class-II energy is not uniformly L1-bounded under the canonical Gaussian reference
analytic_targets.leading_local_contraction: the first divergent derivative-pair contraction is the nonconstant local rational term delta_cube*N*W_eps(Psi); a vacuum constant cannot cancel it, while subtraction is a counterterm candidate for a nondegenerate full-component limit rather than a proved necessity for every possible weak limit

branch_firewall.full_production_shell_mass_squared: derive r-Z^2/(4Y) from the A1 production manifest
branch_firewall.rule: The scalar anchor is checked only for non-identity; it is not used in the full-production covariance.

gates.A6-CLASSII-COUNTERTERM-CLOSURE: Prove that a symmetry-compatible finite renormalisation prescription defines the full Class-II energy and yields uniform stability/tightness.
gates.A6-CLASSII-K-COMPOSITE-DEFINITION: Construct a regulator-independent meaning of K_A=(rho+eps_rho) grad[m_A/(rho+eps_rho)] at the q^-4 Gaussian regularity boundary and prove scheme independence.

closed: exact Gaussian covariance and conditional-current identities
linear max-mode UV exponent and universal cube coefficient
strict positivity of the bare Class-II expected-energy slope
necessity and field dependence of the leading derivative-pair contraction
excluded: rho or Class-II mass regulariser removal
T5, T6, or T7 promotion without operator review
